name: mt-reward-benchmark-arbitrary
description: A benchmark for evaluating machine-translation reward models' ability to assess and rank arbitrary translation outputs, measuring how well automatic reward scores align with human judgements across diverse translation pairs and systems. It contains pairwise and absolute scoring data to test reward-model calibration and ranking performance. The benchmark is intended to stress-test reward models in realistic, heterogeneous MT settings.
reputation: A niche, emerging dataset used primarily by researchers working on MT reward models and evaluation; modest adoption compared to mainstream MT benchmarks.
